🇸🇦🇾🇪‼️🚨 Houthis chant: “This will be the fate of Al Saud: submission and humiliation in Yemen.”

The Houthis shot down a Saudi F-15.

The situation in Yemen stays in the Houthis’ favor. They can hold their gains and defend against other Yemeni groups supported by the Saudis. http
